chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Will Osborne pairs Norvo with Mavis Rivers
summary: Booker Will Osborne combined Mavis Rivers and Norvo's group for Tahoe and the Wagon Wheel, then Sinatra took them to Cal-Neva.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: Yeah, and we worked with Mavis at Vegas, oh a lot of
places out West. Different places, gambling places and -- in Tahoe, Wagon Wheel -- and I tell you who put us together, first. A guy -- an old band leader by the name of Will Osborne.
Will Osborne -- it was around Rudy Vallee's time and the day -- he was the booker at the Wagon Wheel and in Tahoe.
And then we went -- we worked there, she worked as a single. And then I worked as a group, so they opened a new room and he said, I'm going to put the two of you together. So she had --
Yeah, she had arrangements and arrangements made for us behind her and they just worked great. So then the following --
Did we say that it was Mavis Rivers, did we say that when we were on the tape?
I think we said Mavis Rivers, yeah.

And then Sinatra brought us over, same group, over to Cal-Neva that summer, too. So -- and it was fun. But I mean, in other words, all through the musical thing, I've never gone back, I've always kind of like done different things.
